title: n8n subscription workflows
decision: defer — keep BullMQ + optional deploy/worker/scheduler.mjs for POC/Railway

cost.self_hosted_ops: extra container, upgrades, credential store, another failure domain
cost.bullmq_incremental: already in stack (Redis + worker); scheduler profile is a few lines

when_reconsider: Non-engineer operators need visual workflow editing
Cross-product automations (Notion/Slack/CRM) beyond jobby queue kinds
Subscription budget approved and BL-012 scheduler proven insufficient
fail_condition_avoided: Do not introduce n8n without an adopt/defer decision
